collection.title: Jaguar XF Saloon 2007 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Jaguar XF Saloon 2007 to 2015 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
